_about: A synthetic Angular repo of route declarations in every shape the route-availability design needs (a path from a constant, a multi-line declaration, canMatch / canActivate / canActivateChild guards, redirectTo, lazy loadChildren and loadComponent). Never an app's code. Recorded per README.md; codegraph-store-reader.angular-routes.test.ts pins what the engine extracts from it.
